title: Nutty Mellow Dutch Lamb Stew
description: A malty, molten, solo-dinner Dutch dish featuring desiccated coconut and deglaze-fond, made with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients. This hearty stew is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the malt vinegar to the pot and stir to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add the lamb broth, turmeric, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the desiccated coconut and cook for an additional 10 minutes, until heated through.
